summary_bullets: Cover degraded final-summary fallback rendering for bucketed PR line counts
Document that the write-final-report harness includes the degraded bucketed line-count fallback case
commit_message:
Cover PR line counts in final-summary fallback

Add a write-final-report fallback fixture that forces renderer failure while PR line-count data is valid, asserting the degraded summary keeps the fallback marker, PR bullet, and bucketed Lines (PR diff) output. Update the harness sibling doc to name the degraded bucketed line-count coverage.
